lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

British Columbia’s incoming premier says he doesn’t see a quick end to the trade war with the United States despite significant election losses by Republicans under President Donald Trump, The Canadian Press reports.
Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne says Thursday’s federal budget is about giving Canada a “strong footing” to navigate a more volatile world, The Canadian Press reports.
The QEW in Niagara Falls remains closed following a three-vehicle collision that left a truck driver dead on Wednesday afternoon, The Canadian Press reports.
Motorcade escorts remains of soldier killed at CFB Wainwright to B.C. funeral home, Yukon News reports.

U.S. first lady Melania Trump will bring representatives from Russia and Ukraine to the White House on Thursday, after announcing a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky last month, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
